<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 56bf27affbe5e3f5aca8001ed0218d013b04bf22` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5c443c2497b701628c61956850b3c085bd090b58 && git checkout 5c443c2497b701628c61956850b3c085bd090b58
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 56bf27affbe5e3f5aca8001ed0218d013b04bf22 130b8bf9ec4351e2c47ce0526a03b624e144a1ce && git checkout -B drift-repro 56bf27affbe5e3f5aca8001ed0218d013b04bf22 && git merge --no-ff 130b8bf9ec4351e2c47ce0526a03b624e144a1ce

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 56bf27affbe5e3f5aca8001ed0218d013b04bf22
```

</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a

**CI: `Test Core (4/6)` is red on this PR's own change. It is not fixed here, because the fix depends on the scope question on #22057 (6033604558).** `domain:engine#1` · `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi` · 2026-10-07T08:01Z.

- **The failure:** `@objectstack/objectql`, `src/protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts:131` (job 112688876698, head `2d5a5d395b`). It is the #4624 pin, "loadMetaFromDb — ADR-0048 package-scoped protection graft at boot › grafts the envelope from the row's OWN package, not the first-registered one". It reports `expected 'A Home' to be 'B Home (customized)'`.
- **Why:** the pin boots with two packages shipping `page` `home` and one `pkg_b`-bound stored row of it. It asserts that `registry.getItem('page', 'home')` is the row's customized body under `pkg_b`'s envelope. This PR's skip in `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` applies to every type. So that row is no longer registered under the bare name, and the read naming no package gets the first-registered package's shipped item.
- **Not run locally:** the dev ran the full `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite, not `@objectstack/objectql`'s.
- **What decides the fix:** the retriage on #22057.
  - Narrowing the skip to `view` (option B, the seat's recommendation) leaves this pin as it is.
  - Landing it for every type (option A) would need #4624's pinned boot behaviour re-ruled first. ⛔ The pin is not edited to get green.
- **The PR stays a draft** until that answer.

## ACCEPT (seat review) — PR #22066 at head `130b8bf9ec`

`domain:engine#1` · `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi` · read at 2026-10-07T10:21Z. The dev's reports are on #22057: round 1 (6033550720) and the patch round on triage's answer **B** (6034488359). This lands the narrowed shape.

- **The change** is triage's B. The seat read the code lines of the diff in `protocol.ts`:
  - `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` skips a row only when `canonicalType === 'view'`, the row is bound to one package (`boundPackageOf`, which excludes the package-less `sys_metadata` sentinel) and `anotherPackageShips` holds. It then judges the row's expansions one by one, as before.
  - `restoreArtifactRegistryView` tier 2 skips re-registering a baseline only for `canonicalMetaType(type) === 'view'` with the same predicate.
  - `hydrateExpandedViewItems` now asks the shared `anotherPackageShips`, a no-behaviour refactor of its own #21980 check.
  - **Unchanged:** every other type, which still registers under the bare name as #4624 (ADR-0048) rules; a package-less view row; a view row of a name only its own package ships or none ships; and `getMetaItem`'s steps.
- **The four sites (H1).** `:18221` no; `:18564`, `:18990` and `:19284` are yes, `view` only. The enumeration pin `protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts` records each site and pins the view-gating text.
- **Pins:** block (j). (a)–(d) cover `view` in both registry orders, after a save and after a cold boot, on both kernels. (e) is the non-view control: a bound `page` row of a shared name keeps the bare entry with its own body and envelope.
  - Reverse verification on the committed head:
    - Removing the `view` skip turned exactly the 7 predicted cases red, with the base shadow.
    - Widening it back to every type turned exactly (e) red, plus objectql's #4624 pin (`expected 'A Home' to be 'B Home (customized)'`, the first round's CI red).
    - Both legs were restored by blob equality.
  - The full `@objectstack/objectql` suite (379 files, 7513 tests) passed with #4624 unedited, as well as `metadata-protocol`'s full suite.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence against the diff:**
  - "A view row bound to one package is not registered under a name another package ships": matches the `view` gate.
  - "The delete's registry heal also stops re-registering a … view baseline": matches tier 2.
  - "Scope: `view` only. Every other type registers as before": matches (j)(e) and #4624.
  - "The built entry declarations gain one `private` member name": matches the measured `.d.ts` diff.
- **PR body:** the dev wrote the revised body to a file, and the seat applied it in this act through the relay (`issue_patch`, read back identical). It keeps `Fixes #22057` and `Clause-②: no`, the four-site table, and triage's Acceptance notes:
  - (a) the security-metadata bootstraps, `carrier:` #15196;
  - (b) the action router's rung 2 and the picklist read, `承接者:无`;
  - (c) `getMetaItem` step 2 and the delete heal's tier 1 by name, `承接者:无`.
  - #22058 is named in prose only; it stays folded with B, and triage re-reads it when this card closes.
- **Clause-②: no**, `patch`. No door's accept set moves, and no contract surface is touched.
- **CI on `130b8bf9ec`:** 36 success, and the 5 skips are in the roster, after the body edit's checks re-ran.
- **Readings against `main` at `56bf27affb`:** NOT governed (0 of 4 paths), 506 changed lines, and `git merge-tree` is clean.
- **Docs drift:** the bot's 15 pages match only the `sys_metadata` literal in `boundPackageOf` and the class name. None states a view's bare-slot registration. No docs line becomes false.
